summary: Panel de entries from Sami's spine and sourced supplemental seeds, built for per-platform route research.

entries.title: Panel de Pon
entries.definitive_edition: Nintendo Switch Online / Nintendo Classics release of the Super Famicom original

emulation.emulator: Nintendo Classics SNES app, or accurate SNES/Super Famicom emulator for cartridge verification
emulation.notes: Use Switch Online for the original; use Tetris Attack and Nintendo Puzzle Collection only for their distinct presentation/version differences.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Official modern emulation of the 1995 Super Famicom game, plus secondary localized/GameCube variants.

primary.version: Panel de Pon in the Super NES Nintendo Classics app
primary.why: With no Sami platform specified, the Nintendo Switch Online route is the best main playthrough: it is the official modern release of the original Super Famicom Panel de Pon, available through Nintendo Classics, and avoids hunting down Japan-only original hardware.
primary.how_to_play: Play Panel de Pon in the Super NES Nintendo Classics app with a Nintendo Switch Online membership. Use Tetris Attack only to compare the international Yoshi localization, and Nintendo Puzzle Collection only for its later GameCube-era Panel de Pon variant.

secondary.exclusive_content: Tetris Attack localization replaces Panel de Pon's fairy cast and fantasy setting with Yoshi's Island characters/settings.
secondary.what_to_play: Sample the Super NES Tetris Attack version for the localized presentation; use Game Boy only for portable-version curiosity.
secondary.why: The gameplay roots are the same, but the international localization has source-backed presentation differences.

secondary.exclusive_content: Nintendo Puzzle Collection includes a later Panel de Pon variant with updated graphics/music, a new story, and four-player multiplayer.
secondary.what_to_play: Play the GameCube Panel de Pon portion only for its new story/presentation and four-player mode after the original SFC route.
secondary.why: This is a distinct Japan-only collection version rather than a straight port of the SFC original.

entries.remaster_caveats: The Switch Online version is the Japanese original, not an English translation. Tetris Attack is a localization/reskin, and Nintendo Puzzle Collection is a later Japan-only variant rather than a direct replacement.
